claims.text:
novelty-search

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:novelty-search` → `ai-novelty-search` → `src/demos/ai/ai-novelty-search`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/184`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30f.md#11-novelty-search`. **Packet:** E1. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:deceptive-objective`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** deceptive-objective rewards a misleading goal proxy; this computes archive-relative behaviour distances and selects a different route.

**Computed primary model:** Use the precedingS/A/B dead-end graph and detourD/E/F/H/G. Initial archive positionsS,A,B from an earlier stalled run. At restartedS, novelty of candidateendpoint is its Euclidean distance to closest archived point (k1). A novelty0; D novelty1, so chooseD, append its endpoint, then repeatedly prefer the most novel neighbour with positive distance. E,F,H,G each score1 relative to accumulated archive, reaching goal via detour.

**Countercase / boundary:** Add reachable dead-endZ(−5,5) with edgeS–Z. Its nearest archived distance sqrt50>1, so the same novelty rule choosesZ then stalls (only neighbourS has novelty0). Novelty objective is not goal success; archive/descriptor choices matter. This one-endpoint greedy illustration is not the original evolutionary algorithm.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether goal-proxy-favouredA or archive-novelD is chosen first; recall adding a more novel irrelevant branch can distract the same rule.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Novelty step recomputes archive distances and appends endpoints; Add branch reruns on changed graph while retaining successful original novelty and failed goal-greedy witnesses. Keep novelty units distinct from negative goal distance.

**Source obligation:** [Lehman–Stanley original novelty paper PDF](https://www.cs.swarthmore.edu/~meeden/DevelopmentalRobotics/lehman_ecj11.pdf), opened2026-10-19, deception/novelty motivation and behavioural novelty definition. Exact graph, distances/archive and candidates here are declared, not the paper maze experiment or a claim novelty always solves tasks. Opened §4 nearest-neighbour sparseness Eq1, PDFp13; k1 and greedy endpoint selection are explicit simplifications.
